# javap -c -p excerpts and config lines for the crude drying rack's speed (world-sources.json rule grass-plant-fiber:
# "keep it out of the rain: rain on the rack undoes the drying"), from the pinned RotN 3.3.4 server pack zip
# (SHA-256 90642fd5...f5205). Extracted to a scratch folder outside the repo; nothing was run.
# Read by packages/rotn-data/test/grass-tinder.test.js.
#
# Jar and config (SHA-256):
#   mods/pyrotech-1.12.2-1.5.25.jar             2b28dd9274ca66e4d981547c4cce36bc081b2bc925d694dda4249f412cdbf36a
#   config/pyrotech/module.tech.Basic.cfg       98acfc46cba31164461b4c98cc71c8dff486178223d348eed9212c5b777aafb2
#
# What it shows: TileDryingRackBase.updateSpeed (refreshed by workerDoWork when its speed-check counter fires) starts
# from the rack's biome modifier if BIOME_MODIFIERS names the biome (the crude rack's map is an empty static HashMap,
# no config entry); else DIRECT_RAIN when the biome can rain and it rains on the block above the rack, else
# INDIRECT_RAIN when it rains anywhere or the biome has high humidity, else NETHER in the nether, else BASE_DERIVED
# plus the HOT, DRY, COLD and WET biome terms. Then it adds the fire-source bonus, and DAYTIME when it is not raining,
# the sky is visible above the rack and the day time is between 3000 and 9000; and multiplies by
# getMultiplicativeSpeedModifier (the crude rack: CRUDE_DRYING_RACK.SPEED_MODIFIER). workerDoWork adds the speed to
# each slot's partialTicks and subtracts floor(partialTicks) from dryTimeRemaining, clamped to [0, dryTimeTotal]: a
# negative speed adds the time back. With this pack's config, rain on the rack is -3.0 x 1.1 = -3.3 per work step (plus
# any fire-source bonus, also x 1.1), so a rack in the rain loses its progress, back to the full dry time.
